pool_query: mediatype:texts AND language:eng AND creator:* AND year:[1800 TO 2020] AND imagecount:[50 TO 1500] AND (subject:"science fiction" OR subject:fantasy OR subject:("detective and mystery stories" OR "mystery fiction" OR "detective fiction" OR thriller OR thrillers OR "suspense fiction" OR "spy stories" OR "crime fiction"))
assignment: primary genre by precedence science_fiction > fantasy > mystery_thriller
ordering: sha256("2026:<identifier>") ascending within each genre (not by views/downloads)
views_check_note: have_data checked once at build time
in_americana_note: v1 books are all Americana; new books carry their own flag
